target: An exact-byte shadow content store plus ordered manifests, resumable per-stream checkpoints, explicit conflict explanations, and verified reconstruction.
primary_semantics: Derived shadow storage and transfer helpers prove exact byte identity and resumability without replacing, rewriting, merging, deleting, or granting remote authority over source archives.
invariants: Raw history, summaries, archive-v1, environment-v1, their cursors, ledgers, and failure semantics remain unchanged.
Object identity is SHA-256 over exact persisted bytes; no normalization, reserialization, semantic deduplication, AI, or vectors participate.
Every manifest is closed, ordered, path-safe, and records source identity, byte length, and file hash.
A stream is complete only after ordered reconstruction matches every object and the whole-file hash.
Deleting or disabling the shadow store leaves every authoritative source byte readable and unchanged.
allowed_changes: Add a removable shadow object store and immutable ordered source manifests.
Add independent per-stream transfer checkpoints and bounded segment staging.
Add duplicate, replay, overlap, missing, corrupt, and conflict diagnostics.
Expose preview-first local CLI adapters for build, verify, transfer, reconstruct, and disable.
Add fixed MW28 exact-byte, interruption, replay, isolation, and rollback cases.
prohibited_changes: Rewrite, normalize, compact, merge, delete, or garbage-collect source archives or shadow objects.
Resolve conflicts automatically or infer semantic equivalence.
Grant one device write authority over another device's raw archive.
Replace or modify archive-v1 or environment-v1 payload codecs, cursors, ledgers, acknowledgements, or failure semantics.
before_after_checks: Hash immutable source fixtures before shadow build, transfer failures, reconstruction, disable, and shadow removal.
Compare every manifest entry byte length and SHA-256 with its source and reconstructed bytes.
Interrupt each stream at fixed checkpoints, restart, replay ranges, and prove exact final equality.
Inject overlap, missing, corrupt, wrong-source, wrong-target, and conflicting segment cases.
Disable and remove the shadow path, then prove original archive readability and unchanged hashes.
